title: Endless Paradise | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book:* 0.2 miles from Lake Causeway Beach Access* Private Saltwater Pool- Optional Pool Heating Available for $50/night* 4 Bikes Included!* Gourmet Kitchen and Lush Outdoor Green Space* Short Drive to Gulf Place Town Center* Professional
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book:* 0.2 miles from Lake Causeway Beach Access* Private Saltwater Pool- Optional Pool Heating Available for $50/night* 4 Bikes Included!* Gourmet Kitchen and Lush Outdoor Green Space* Short Drive to Gulf Place Town Center* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. *Welcome to Endless Paradise, where the sun, sand, and sea await you! As you step into our beach oasis, you'll be greeted with warm, open-air vibes and breathtaking views through large windows. The kitchen is equipped with granite countertops, a breakfast bar, and stainless steel appliances, perfect for the group's next culinary endeavor. For your convenience, this home has a washer, dryer, and a pack-n-play stored in the laundry room for your use. Endless Paradise sleeps up to 10 guests, with sleeping arrangements that include 3 King Beds, 4 Twin Beds, and a queen sleeper sofa for additional sleeping! Step outside and enjoy the coastal lifestyle with our private pool to enjoy all the Florida sun!*We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Hillcrest is a quaint street in Dune Allen Beach along Scenic Highway 30A. This area is convenient to Gulf Place Town Center while being just off the beaten path. The home is just a short walk to the serene Oyster Lake, which is great for fishing, while Topsail Hill Preserve State Park offers breathtaking trails for hiking and exploring. Bed Setup:~ Master Suite 1 (Main, 1st Floor): King Bed~ Guest Suite 2 (1st Floor): King Bed~ Guest Suite 3 (1st Floor): King Bed~ Guest Bunk Room (2nd Floor): Queen Sleeper Sofa and 2 Twin-Over-Full Bunks Area Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. Read less
